author: NASA
text:
How’s that for a starburst?

Found in this distant spiral galaxy is a giant star prone to mysterious outbursts. Thanks to @ChandraXray, scientists identified the culprit behind the eruptions—a hidden companion to the volatile star. https://go.nasa.gov/4kK4xGH
